description: This PHP file defines the SuiteValidator class in the SuiteCRM\Utility namespace. It provides validation methods for IDs and keys, as well as checking if a field is a percentage-related field. The class interacts with global configuration variables to determine validation patterns.

classes.name: SuiteValidator
classes.description: A utility class for various validation checks within the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: isValidId
methods.description: Checks if a given ID string or numeric value is valid based on a validation pattern, considering strict validation if configured.

methods.name: isValidKey
methods.description: Checks if a given key string is valid based on a validation pattern.

methods.name: isPercentageField
methods.description: Determines if a field name is related to percentage or VAT fields based on its name.

methods.name: getIdValidationPattern
methods.description: Retrieves the ID validation pattern, either strict or default, based on configuration.

methods.name: getKeyValidationPattern
methods.description: Retrieves the key validation pattern, either from configuration or default pattern.
